t: 荷兰和英国分舰队之间长达四天的海战结束,英国人遭受了更重的损失.
te: A four day long naval engagement between the Dutch and English fleet ends, with the English suffering heavier losses.
dz: 荷兰和英国分舰队之间长达四天的海战结束,英国人遭受了更重的损失.
de: A four day long naval engagement between the Dutch and English fleet ends, with the English suffering heavier losses.

t: 海军少将罗伯特·福尔摩斯领导了对荷兰特尔谢林岛的突袭,摧毁了116至160艘商船,这一行为后来…
te: Rear Admiral Robert Holmes leads a raid on the Dutch island of Terschelling, destroying 116 to 160 merchant ships, an a…
dz: 第二次盎格鲁-荷兰战争:海军少将罗伯特·福尔摩斯领导了对荷兰特尔谢林岛的突袭,摧毁了116至160艘商船,这一行为后来被称作"霍尔梅斯的邦火".
de: Second Anglo-Dutch War: Rear Admiral Robert Holmes leads a raid on the Dutch island of Terschelling, destroying 116 to 160 merchant ships, an act later known as "Holmes's Bonfire".

te: The Great Fire of London breaks out and burns for three days, destroying 10,000 buildings, including Old St Paul's Cath…
dz: 伦敦大火爆发并燃烧了三天，摧毁了包括老圣保罗大教堂在内的 10,000 座建筑物。
de: The Great Fire of London breaks out and burns for three days, destroying 10,000 buildings, including Old St Paul's Cathedral.

te: The Royal Exchange burns down in the Great Fire of London.
dz: 皇家交易所在伦敦大火中被烧毁.
de: The Royal Exchange burns down in the Great Fire of London.

te: In London, England, the most destructive damage from the Great Fire occurs.
dz: 在英国伦敦,由"大火"造成的最有破坏性的破坏发生.

te: The most intense tornado on record in English history, an F4 storm on the Fujita scale or T8 on the TORRO scale, strike…
dz: 英格兰历史上记录到的最强龙卷风袭击林肯郡，强度为藤田级数 F4 或 TORRO 级数 T8，风速超过每小时 213 英里（343 公里）。
de: The most intense tornado on record in English history, an F4 storm on the Fujita scale or T8 on the TORRO scale, strikes the county of Lincolnshire, with winds of more than 213 miles per hour (343 km/h).

de: At least 3,000 men of the Royal Scots Army led by Tam Dalyell of the Binns defeat about 900 Covenanter insurgents led by James Wallace of Auchens in the Battle of Rullion Green.
